i Where is my world save? On Windows, Necesse keeps worlds in %APPDATA%\Necesse\saves\worlds. Paste it into the File Explorer address bar. The usual full path isC:\Users\you\AppData\Roaming\Necesse\saves\worlds Each world is a .zip named after the world, for example Main.zip.
